textRuns.value: Sources: Open-Meteo (weather, average of each country's cities), Eurostat (population, GDP per person, household electricity price excl. taxes, unemployment). Degree days: base 18 °C. Demand per person only uses country-years with at least 95 % of hours covered (Cyprus: none; Ireland: 2024 only). Ireland's demand covers the all-island market (incl. Northern Ireland), so its per-person figure is overstated. Bulgaria and Malta are excluded.
